text.tspan: Using at least basic drinking water sources in urban vs. rural areas 2024
Share of urban versus rural population using at least a basic drinking water source; that is, an improved source
within 30 minutes round trip to collect water.

tspan.tspan: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene (2025)
Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2014 and 2023 is shown instead.
